newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Netanyahu blames Arafat for Tel Aviv bomb.
newsitem.headline: Netanyahu blames Arafat for Tel Aviv bomb.

text.p: Israel's Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu accused Yasser Arafat's Palestinian Authority of indirectly giving a green light to bombers who killed four people in a blast on Friday at a Tel Aviv sidewalk cafe.

"I said these organisations understood from the things that were said to them they had the approval of the Palestinian Authority...There is no doubt they acted on the basis of that understanding," he told reporters at a hospital where wounded were being treated.
